description: A React component plugin named ReadonlyPlugin that manages the read-only state of a note within a Lexical editor, syncing the note's lock status and controlling editor editability.

methods.name: ReadonlyPlugin
methods.description: React functional component that connects a note's lock state with the Lexical editor's editability feature.

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: The note object that contains the lock status and UUID.
